quotes.text: Bug 1897819 found that tab lookup compared t.chromeBrowser to a fallback embedderElement that was often null. A content tab also had null chromeBrowser, so find() returned it first and the mail-tab folder event was dropped. The landed fix required a real chromeBrowser before either comparison. Current code changed to matching the target window through optional chromeBrowser chaining, which preserves the non-null identity check. In tab-to-browser lookup, guard missing values before fallback equality.
